section.heading: Modified application of the Judicial Misbehaviour and Incapacity (Parliamentary Commissions) Act 2012

content.p: (1) The object of this section is to modify the application of the Judicial Misbehaviour and Incapacity (Parliamentary Commissions) Act 2012 (the JMIPC Act) so as to allow a Commission to be established by the Houses of Parliament to investigate and report on alleged misbehaviour or incapacity of an FWC Member, so the Houses can be well-informed to consider whether to pray for:
the termination of the FWC Member’s appointment under section 641; or

the removal of the FWC Member from office under section 82 or 86 of the WR Act (within the meaning of the Transitional Act), as those sections continue to apply because of the operation of item 2 of Schedule 18 to the Transitional Act.

The JMIPC Act applies, in addition to its general application, as if a provision of that Act referred to in an item in column 1 of the following table were amended as specified in column 2 of the item.

division.heading: Amendments made by Schedule 1 to the amending Act

content.p: Scope
This clause applies in relation to a review of a modern award conducted as part of a 4 yearly review of modern awards if:
the review of the modern award commenced before the Schedule 1 commencement day; and
immediately before that day, the review of the modern award had not been completed.
Saving
Despite the repeal of:
Division 4 of Part 2-3 (which deals with 4 yearly reviews of modern awards); and
paragraph 582(4)(a) (which deals with directions by the President); and
subsections 616(2) and (3) (which deal with the FWC’s functions etc. that must be performed by a Full Bench);
by the amending Act, those provisions continue to apply, in relation to the review of the modern award, as if those repeals had not happened.

Despite the repeal of paragraph 582(4)(a) (which deals with directions by the President) by the amending Act, a direction given by the President to an FWC Member under that paragraph that was in force immediately before the Schedule 1 commencement day continues to have effect, in relation to the review of the modern award, as if that repeal had not happened.
Common issues
For the purposes of this clause, it is immaterial whether the review of the modern award is conducted in relation to an issue that the modern award has in common with another modern award.

On or after the Schedule 1 commencement day, the FWC may dismiss an application under section 158 to vary, revoke or make a modern award if the FWC is satisfied that the specific matters in relation to which the application is made were dealt with, or are being dealt with, in a 4 yearly review of modern awards.
Note: For another power of the FWC to dismiss applications under section 158, see section 587.
This clause does not limit when the FWC may dismiss an application under section 158.
Sunset provision
This clause ceases to have effect at the end of 2 years after the Schedule 1 commencement day.

division.heading: Amendments made by Schedule 2 to the amending Act

section.heading: Application of amendments—when employees have genuinely agreed to an enterprise agreement

content.p: The amendments of section 188 of this Act made by Schedule 2 to the amending Act apply in relation to an application made under section 185 of this Act for approval of an enterprise agreement if the application is made:
on or after the Schedule 2 commencement day; or
before the Schedule 2 commencement day, if circumstances covered by subclause (2) apply.
The circumstances covered by this subclause are:
on or before the Schedule 2 commencement day, the FWC had neither approved, nor refused to approve, the enterprise agreement; or
before the Schedule 2 commencement day:
the FWC approved, or refused to approve, the enterprise agreement; and
an application was made under section 604 for an appeal against the decision to approve, or refuse to approve, the enterprise agreement; and
the FWC had not yet made a final decision on the appeal; or
all of the following apply:
within 21 days before the Schedule 2 commencement day, the FWC approved, or refused to approve, the enterprise agreement;
immediately before the Schedule 2 commencement day, an application had not been made under section 604 for an appeal against the decision to approve, or refuse to approve, the enterprise agreement;
within 21 days after the FWC approved, or refused to approve, the enterprise agreement, an application is made under section 604 for an appeal against that decision.

division.heading: Amendments made by Schedule 3 to the amending Act

section.heading: Application of section 641B of the amended Act

content.p: Section 641B of the amended Act applies in relation to alleged misbehaviour or incapacity of an FWC Member occurring before or after the commencement of Schedule 3 to the amending Act.
